title: Stained Glass Heraldic Crest
description: A vibrant stained glass window featuring a central heraldic shield with a blue fleur-de-lis, three pinecones, and a knight's helmet with red plume above. The shield is framed by ornate teal scrollwork, orange flowers at the bottom, and a banner reading 'FOREL'. The background shows a radiant sunburst, starry cosmic sky, and ethereal flowing figures.
prompt: A highly detailed stained glass window displaying a heraldic crest. Central shield divided with a blue fleur-de-lis on white and three blue pinecones on black and white sections. Silver knight helmet with red plume sits above the shield, surrounded by ornate teal acanthus scrollwork. White banner below reads 'FOREL'. Bottom corners filled with bright orange flowers, background features radiant golden sunburst rays and a starry cosmic blue sky with flowing ethereal figures.
